name: apnews
description: AP News (apnews.com), a news wire site. No CLI commands can be built from this recording, because every page was behind a Cloudflare bot check.
notes: The only recorded request was GET https://apnews.com/. It returned a 307 redirect to a Cloudflare bot check, not article data, so no command could replay it and get results.
/hub/politics was also blocked by the Cloudflare check. No XHR, fetch or JSON endpoints were seen.
robots.txt disallows /search, so a keyword search command must not be built against apnews.com/search.

To build commands, re-explore with a browser session that passes the Cloudflare check. Record section/hub listings (e.g. /hub/{section}), article pages (/article/{slug}) and any embedded JSON or JSON-LD on them. Then build HTML or jsonScript extract commands from that recording.
No commands were invented from guessed URLs, because the verifier needs commands that come from recorded requests with real results.
